gate: GPU_LONG_TRAJECTORY_V1 - (A) does the CPU + GPU hybrid path stay endpoint-identical to CPU E2 for 1000 consecutive steps; (B) can the existing P2 precision retry (restart from the original state at the next p) run on the GPU path without any change of meaning, including the precisions P2 actually produces (73, 78, 161, 166); (C) can the GPU path be frozen as a selectable execution candidate (GPU backend semantic contract) for ADAPTIVE_EXECUTION_V1? Correctness first; performance only after every correctness gate.
classification: A FROZEN CANDIDATE IS NOT A SELECTOR: the GPU is not put into any selector in this gate

reference_semantics.trajectory: exactly stream.run (exact=False) at one p: F_0 = forces(q_0); for s = 0..T-1: p_half = p_s + F_s; q_{s+1} = q_s + p_half * cdt; F_{s+1} = forces(q_{s+1}); p_{s+1} = p_half + F_{s+1}; F_{s+1} reused as the next F: T + 1 force evaluations for a completed pass
reference_semantics.pass_record: as multiatom_parallel_v1.run._readout: completed_steps, stop (VIOLATED / UNPROVEN / OUT_OF_RANGE), stop_step (state index), and at T: cells (K.decide), endpoints_key, endpoints_scaled (evaluator_adapter._scaled_endpoints: positions x 2^48, momenta x 2^80); outcome = DOMAIN_VIOLATED_PROVEN / DOMAIN_UNPROVEN / OUT_OF_RANGE / DECIDED / UNDECIDED_AT_PRECISION
reference_semantics.service: as experience_start_p_v2.service.run_request: first p = start p (BASE64: 64, FAMILY_MAX: 163); every later p = precision_pilot_a1.policies.next_p('P2', None, history, T) on the pass records (p2_view); stop when P2 returns None (final outcome), CAP or 24 passes; EVERY pass starts from the original (q0, p0)
reference_semantics.comparison_rule: a pass at p is compared with the CPU at the same p (endpoint for endpoint); between policies / precisions only the final DECIDED cells (the physical result) are compared, never endpoints

gate_P_gpu_precision_support.question: can the GPU evaluate the precisions P2 actually produced in the verified T = 1000 requests exactly?
gate_P_gpu_precision_support.no_full_sweep: 64..192 is not swept; only the p with information value for this question
gate_P_gpu_precision_support.mechanism: a new host layer in experiments/gpu_long_trajectory_v1 (support.py): ExtPV = pv_host.PV whose upload accepts p in SEALED_EXT_P = {64, 73, 78, 109, 128, 161, 163, 166, 192} by calling the unchanged PV / G0 upload with gpu_host.SUPPORTED_P temporarily widened by that one p for the duration of the call (a runtime scope, no file change); any other p -> REFUSED_DEVICE_PRECISION. The CUDA code, rounding, limbs, exp algorithm, working precision (wp = p + 14) and gpu_host.py are NOT changed; trace, constants and exp tables are produced by the unchanged code for that p
gate_P_gpu_precision_support.states: real positions from the bundle trajectories at that p: N12 (p 64, 73, 161, 163) and N16 (p 64, 78, 166, 163) at states 0, 250, 500, 750, 1000, and for p = 64 also the last completed state and the stop state (which contains the UNPROVEN pair)
gate_P_gpu_precision_support.per_state_checks: every pair: status (domain) equal, r2 equal, obligations mask complete, G equal, J x/y/z equal (PAIR_EXACT; PAIR_UNSOUND counted separately), device precision echo == requested p, first stopping pair equal; atom F equal when all pairs PROVEN; positions echo equal; layouts 32 and 128 identical. d is not a device output: it is covered through r2 and J (disclosed)
gate_P_gpu_precision_support.targets: endpoint EXACT 100 %, UNSOUND 0, domain mismatch 0, silent overflow 0, precision echo mismatch 0
gate_P_gpu_precision_support.outcome: GPU_SUPPORTED_P = the baseline p that pass plus every new p that passes all checks; GPU_UNSUPPORTED_P = every new p that fails or is refused. A failing baseline p -> LONG_FAIL. The independent checker writes gpu_support.json; the service phase reads only that file
gate_P_gpu_precision_support.disguise_faults: requested 73 / device 78 and requested 161 / device 163 must be detected (device precision echo and values)

long_runner.executor: LongExecutor: GpuForceExecutor semantics (unchanged force path) on ExtPV, counting model uploads, allocations and force evaluations, recording the device precision echo of every force (atom record word 2)
long_runner.persistence: inside a pass: no context creation, no model upload, no allocation (checked = 0); between passes of a service: one model upload when p changes (counted and timed), allocation reused for the same N
long_runner.first_divergence: the runner dumps the five vectors of the first step whose digests differ from the bundle; the checker reports first_divergence_state, stage, atom, component, end, CPU endpoint, GPU endpoint, precision
long_runner.fallback: a requested p not in GPU_SUPPORTED_P runs on the CPU E2 serial path (stream.run unchanged, the pass record by _readout) at exactly that p; the pass is marked backend CPU_E2_FALLBACK; the request status is GPU_FULL_RETRY when every pass ran on the GPU and GPU_WITH_CPU_PRECISION_FALLBACK otherwise; a p is never replaced by another p

checker: independent: imports none of the long runner, service, campaign, support (precision wrapper), traj, one_step, pv_host or GPU code; own literal CPU forces / KDK (iv objects), own digests, own pass readout (K.decide, K.endpoints_key, own scaled endpoints), own P2 implementation from the rule text above (not policies.py), own service restart semantics (every pass from the own FCC initial state); compares per pass: p sequence, outcome, completed steps, stop state, stop pair, per-step digests, checkpoint endpoints, final endpoints and cells, force evaluation counts, persistence counters, device precision echo; compares its own pass records with the V2 references where (N, T, p) exist; for gate P its own per-pair r2 / G / J / statuses
fault_injections (the checker must detec: 1 step 500 uses the previous step's F
10 continuing after the long domain stop
12 the retry pass starts from the failed pass's last state
14 an unsupported p silently raised to the next supported p
15 GPU model at the old p while the record says the new p
16 the failed pass deleted from the record
17 the final successful pass's endpoint altered

decision_rules_sealed.GPU_V1_READY: N12 p163 T1000 exact, N16 p163 T1000 exact, long stops exact, P2 retry semantics exact, silent precision substitution 0, final physical result exact (service cells = CPU), N16 GPU_WIN, and every P2-produced p in GPU_SUPPORTED_P (N12 may be TIE)
decision_rules_sealed.next_if_ready: ADAPTIVE_EXECUTION_V1 (the GPU becomes a selectable candidate only there)

not_in_scope: KDK / position / momentum on the GPU
changing gpu_host.SUPPORTED_P or any frozen file
claims_forbidden: exactness at the tested p implies every p
an unsupported p is an error of physics
endpoints at different p should be equal
